title: Skeptical
paragraphs: “For now, it seems safe to say that we’ve resolved most of what we could regarding Melromarc.”
“Yes. Depending on the situation, we may have to return, but I believe we can consider our mission accomplished.”
After saying that, Itsuki furrowed his brows and began thinking deeply.
“…Is this really a resolution?”
“Hmm… at least within the scope of what we can do.”
Itsuki had heard from me before about how cases like this often end up only partially resolved. He probably has a lingering sense of unease.

“If there is any silver lining to all this, it’s that those who were skeptical of the Three Heroes Church’s teachings have survived. Now is the time for Melromarc to be reborn. I intend to do everything in my power to guide the country in a better direction.”
The queen lightly tapped her staff against the ground. The Seven Star Weapon staff stood out prominently.

“For the portion that Aultcray entrusted to me, I must now reign as the symbol of this nation. Heroes, there may come a time when I ask for your assistance again. When that time comes, would you be willing to lend your aid?”

At this point, even maintaining the appearance of a functioning nation was a challenge. Still, as long as the queen existed as the newly chosen Staff Hero, Father and the others had discussed yesterday that things would somehow work out.
“Of course. Well… this whole situation is partly our fault too.”
“Yeah. There’s no way we can just ignore a country in this state.”
“If this leads to the end of discrimination and a better nation, then I won’t hesitate to cooperate.”
“Either way, we need to teach Her Majesty the proper way to strengthen the staff and prepare for the Waves.”
“Yes… I will put the knowledge you heroes have shared into practice and do my best to save the world as soon as possible.”
With that, the discussion seemed to reach a conclusion. A queen who could wield a weapon was far more useful than Trash, who couldn’t.
“Now then… as for our next steps, we should first return to Forbrey to report, correct?”
“We also can’t forget to confront the Waves in other countries. There are meetings with the other Seven Star Heroes as well.”
“And we still need to find out where Imiya’s relatives were taken.”
Father grasped the mole’s hand before looking toward the queen.
“Yes, the country is in this state, but we will conduct an immediate search. As soon as we find any information, we will report it to you.”
“Y-Yes.”
The mole anxiously gazed at the devastated castle town. It wasn’t just me who felt that there was a certain hopelessness reflected in those eyes.
“Imiya, don’t give up.”
Father lifted the mole into his arms and spoke.
“Y-Yes…”

If they were taken away by slave hunters, wouldn’t they have been traded in the many slave markets scattered throughout the back alleys of the castle town? In other words, I suspect their survival is hopeless. I don’t know where Father got his information, though.
Either way, it all depends on how many corpses of the mole’s kin can be found, doesn’t it?
“I’ve never met them personally, but I do have connections with a slave trader. That trader noticed the country’s instability and decided to withdraw, so I’ll reach out to them.”
“Please do.”
“Naofumi, you really do look after others well. Just from seeing her now, I can tell how much Imiya wants to do her best.”
“That’s true.”
More than that mole, though, Sakura-chan has been feeling lonely lately—
“Mel-chan, cheer up!”
“That’s right. If you wear a gloomy expression, it will only make the common folk uneasy.”
“Let’s do our best!”

“It’s okay, Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, Kou. Mother’s country is being rebuilt with the help of many people. There’s nothing to be sad about, and in the first place, this is Father and Sister’s responsibility. I just have to work even harder.”

She doesn’t seem all that lonely, considering she spends every day with her fiancé. Since Yuki-chan and the others couldn’t be made to do reconstruction work in such a grim place, they were supporting Sakura-chan while she helped her fiancé. However, Sakura-chan, that fiancé also belongs to Filo-tan. So if you get too close to him, Filo-tan won’t have the chance to rebuild their friendship. I’ll have to remind Father about this later.
“Na~ Imiya-chan being carried by Naofumi is so unfair, na~!”
The rival and the assistant are as lively as ever.
And then there’s… Éclair, I suppose? She seems somewhat uncomfortable.
“Your Majesty, I…”
“I understand how you feel. However, serving the heroes under the name of Seaetto is also for the good of the country.”
So the queen has commanded Éclair to work with us as one of our companions, has she? What is she so conflicted about?
“Éclair, you want to help with the country’s reconstruction efforts, right? You don’t have to worry too much about us—”
“This is a matter of Melromarc’s accountability, and it is also for Melromarc’s sake. Heroes, please allow Lady Seaetto to accompany you in battle.”
Given Melromarc’s precarious political situation, Éclair’s position as a companion to the heroes must have become a crucial one.

“Of course, I promise the restoration of the Seaetto territory. As for its reconstruction, I intend to entrust it to someone who understood your father well, Lady Seaetto. Do your utmost to be of aid to the heroes.”
It seems Ren and Itsuki already understand this, as they nod in agreement. It’s not a bad proposal, after all. Father seems to want to respect Éclair’s wishes.
“Hah!”
Éclair salutes once more, reaffirming her commitment to the queen’s command.
“Are you really okay with this?”

“Iwatani-dono, please don’t say things that would make my resolve waver. Besides, I was only ever trained in combat and etiquette. When it comes to governing a territory… there are more suitable candidates than me.”
Éclair speaks with a faint sense of sadness. In the first world, Éclair’s domain had belonged to Father.

In that sense, wouldn’t it be best for Father to take charge of it? That said, while Father has managed the village, I heard he left the actual governance of the territory to others. It’s a delicate balance. He must have heard from me about this before, which is why he isn’t offering to take it on himself.

“Lord Iwatani, please act not only for our country but for the world. With three of the Seven Star Heroes who were supposed to be chosen missing, we are no longer in a position to protect just our nation and the neighboring ones.”

The duties that should have been carried out by the Seven Star Heroes have now fallen upon us, the Four Holy Heroes. The queen is likely telling us that we cannot afford to focus solely on reconstruction efforts.
“I see… Understood. Then, Your Majesty, do your best as the Staff Hero.”
“Yes…”
The queen gazes up at the sky with distant eyes. I wonder if, in her mind, she sees Trash’s face reflected there. Not to be outdone, I also look up at the sky, remembering Filo-tan.
Ah… Filo-tan, where are you now?
“Hey, even Motoyasu’s starting to stare off into the distance.”
“He’s probably just lost in some delusion. It’s better to leave him alone than to risk him acting up.”
“As long as he’s not thinking about anything weird…”
“For now, let’s head back to Faubrey and get some rest. We’ve been exhausted from all these consecutive days, and… I think the waves in other countries are drawing closer.”

And so, we decided to return to Faubrey to prepare for the upcoming waves. --- Back in Faubrey, we rested until the Pig King woke up. Now that he’s awake, we are currently in the middle of an audience with him.
“Bufufufufu… Well done returning, Heroes of the Four Saints.”
As always, the Pig King seems to be in a good mood, playing with Takt’s pig minions.
I wonder if they filmed another animal video?
“Ahem… For your recent deeds, I, as the representative of Faubrey, extend my commendations.”
And once again, a cheat sheet? One of his ministers, who looks like a new one, is holding up a script for him.
